About:
Our mission in the Webster County Recorder’s Office is to efficiently, accurately, and quickly record and preserve records. We record and preserve land records, issue marriage license, record and issue copies of military discharge papers (DD214).
DOCUMENT SEARCH WEBSITE – ONLINE AS OF 2/1/2023
You will need to register as a New User
Once registered you will have access to search and purchase documents
Levels of subscriptions range from Free to several options depending on your needs!
Document Search for Index of Recorded Deeds Click Link to get started!
Free Service www.deedwatch.com
Marriage license requirements:
ONLINE MARRIAGE APPLICATION (Optional but speeds up the process)
Both parties must be present with a valid government-issued identification
If previously married, you must know the month and year your last marriage ended.
Your social security number
Licenses are valid for 30 days and must be used in the state of Missouri.
Marriage license fees:
Marriage license $53 – Cash Only
Certified copy $9 – This is used to change your name on your drivers licenses and social security card.
Document standards
3 inch top margin on first page
All other margins 3/4″
8 ½ by 11 white paper
Fees for Documents
Standard documents
First page – $26
Each additional page – $3
Non-standard documents – Add $25 penalty fee to recording fee
Copies of recorded documents are $1.00 per page
